FrozenQualificationBinary.Limit: The earlier focused host differs in commit metadata; this verifies its named contracts passed against the final measured core in the complete suite.

ReviewProbe.ValidationGapsAtReviewSettledBy: All three framework suites, exact tested/measured net10 core hash match and netstandard2.0 build. Frozen corpus and benchmark results are qualified separately.

ChangedDecoders: QR closest-format and all-format passes share one search state. Each format candidate is corrected and parsed at most once, in the existing priority order.

Noisy-format searches reuse immutable extracted codewords by mask across both passes; correction receives private working bytes. The owning module decode returns the pooled cache on success, failure, cancellation and exceptions. Clean-format searches do not rent a cache or allocate a state object.

Payload failure evidence spans both passes, while final failure mask and correction-level metadata follow the original sorted order. A valid-parity malformed-payload regression exercises the closest-to-all fallback.
No public API, production dependency, comparison hint, oracle, scoring rule, total timeout or recognition allowance changes.
AttributionLimits: This follow-up records 198/267 correct positive images versus 198/267 in the previous pass. Previously correct images lost: none; gained: none. Paired negative completion is [29, 30, 30, 30]/31 with the current binary and [29, 29, 27, 30]/31 with the previous qualified binary. All outcomes remain sensitive to shared-host contention and wall-clock budgets; no universal timeout or recognition advantage is established. QR candidate and extraction reuse removes repeated work without changing the total or family recognition allowances. Demonstrated regression gains do not establish accuracy on unseen photographs. Supplemental PDF417 images are regression evidence informed by prior remediation, not an unseen holdout. The invalid GS1 AI (3922) oracle and undeclared QR character encoding policies remain unchanged in scoring. Stacked DataBar and Expanded Stacked multiple-symbol localization and arbitrary perspective remain unproved; MaxiCode image scanning is unsupported.

RegressionProof.Coverage: The malformed-payload case preserves payload failure evidence from the closest candidates through broader fallback. Existing erased-format single-block and multi-block recovery, all eight masks, cancellation/reuse, enclosing QR deadlines and scanner completion contracts remain qualified.
RegressionProof.HistoricalProof: Previous stacked DataBar qualification remains historical in previous-qualification.json and its retained archive. Current full suites, frozen corpus, supplemental images and timings are rerun.
RegressionProof.FocusedBinaryLimit: Focused experiments used a precommit diagnostic core. The complete final suites rerun those contracts against the frozen core used by the measurement host.

TestExecution.Net472: Task-local runner configuration disables collection parallelism; recognition allowances and assertions are unchanged.
TestExecution.Limit: Short wall-clock allowances remain sensitive to shared-host load. Serial legacy qualification is not proof for default parallel execution.
